title: Ignition Cut v3 - dwell-zero rev limiter [DEPRECATED: gates on speed, use V7]
description: DEPRECATED and remove-only. This dwell-zero revision gates on vehicle speed at 0xF19A rather than engine speed and does not use the coil final-stage path. Retained only so an installed V3 can be detected and reverted before installing Ignition Cut V7.
